rv.q: Apparently the answer is everywhere. This is a show to be enjoyed.
BrightSide's production is polished so brightly it sparkles and shines like Times Square.

Although everything about this show is top notch, it all comes together perfectly due to the palpable chemistry between the two main characters: Max Bialystock and Scott Kelley deliver burlesque antics that recall the song-and-dance clowns of yesteryear.
Brightside's production features a stellar cast performing this laugh-out-loud, raucous show.
